assessment: This article is an important contribution to the microglia field and will be of interest to a broad readership in the fields of neurobiology, cell biology, and immunology. This work describes fundamental mechanisms of efferocytosis by microglia and uses impressive imaging in zebrafish, in combination with molecular manipulations, to provide compelling data of how centrosome movements synchronize with phagocytic cup formation during microglial efferocytosis of neuronal corpses in vivo.
